surface-raised.$description: Hover state, selected row, input fields

accent.$description: Primary buttons, links, active navigation item, focus ring. Text on it uses bg (UI-004)

accent-deep.$description: Pressed state of a primary button

status-down.$description: Device or check is down. Error messages

status-degraded.$description: Slow response or high resource usage

status-unknown.$description: No data, or the check is paused

chart-grid.$description: Chart grid lines (K5, MET-004). Same colour as border in the dark theme; the light theme uses nord-4, so a grid never matches series 1 (R-086)

chart-axis.$description: Chart axis labels (K5, MET-004). Same colour as text-muted

chart-threshold.$description: Chart 85 % threshold line (K5, MET-004). Same colour as status-degraded

chart-series-1.$description: Chart series 1 (K5, MET-004). Nord frost, then aurora; series 5 and 6 share the maintenance and warning hues, so a chart must not tell them apart by hue alone
